title: PVC Foam Boards
tagline: Lightweight, durable, and ultra-smooth finish for modern architecture
description: Defenseply PVC Foam Boards are engineered for superior structural integrity and aesthetic perfection. Built with premium cellular polymers, they deliver an ultra-smooth finish that is lightweight yet remarkably durable, impervious to moisture, termites, and fire.
extendedDescription: Engineered to replace traditional plywood and MDF, Defenseply PVC Foam Boards eliminate the common risks of swelling, delamination, and pest attacks. The uniform cell structure provides an impeccable surface for lamination, direct digital printing, or painting.
Whether specified for luxury modular kitchens, high-humidity bathroom vanities, or intricate wall claddings, these boards maintain dimensional stability in extreme ambient conditions without warping.

tagline: Coloured PVC high-finish boards with zero lead time and no painting required

title: WPC Boards
tagline: The best of wood and plastic combined: high screw holding, eco-friendly, and waterproof
description: Defenseply WPC Boards fuse virgin polymers with fine natural wood fibers using precision German extrusion technology. The result is a high-density, eco-friendly composite that delivers the warmth and workability of timber with total immunity to moisture, rot, termites, and fungal decay.
extendedDescription: Manufactured at our dedicated 2-acre production facility along the Panvel–Kochi–Kanyakumari National Highway in KINFRA Industrial Park, Kuttippuram, Kerala. With an installed capacity of 110,400 boards annually, each board is precision-calibrated for thickness and density.
Unlike ordinary composites, Defenseply WPC features extraordinary screw withdrawal strength, can be cut with standard carpentry tools, and takes paints, polishes, and laminates with supreme adhesion.

title: WPC Door Frames
tagline: Tough, stylish, & built to last for generations without warping or rot
description: Defenseply WPC Door Frames are precision-engineered solid profiles that replace costly, high-maintenance timber jambs. With high material density and exceptional screw withdrawal strength, they provide a rock-solid foundation for any interior or exterior door.
extendedDescription: Natural wooden door frames are notorious for absorbing moisture, rotting near floor tiles, and falling victim to termites. Defenseply door frames are 100% waterproof, termite-proof, pest-proof, and virtually maintenance-free.

Produced at our KINFRA industrial facility with an annual capacity of 201,142 meters of WPC frames, each profile is ready for direct installation, accepts standard door hinges and locks, and features a smooth finish with the elegance of real wood.

tagline: Robust solid composite doors engineered for excellence in every environment

title: 3 Layer Boards
tagline: Enhanced strength, impact resistance, and a glossy waterproof surface for modern construction
description: Built with a robust three-layered structure, Defenseply 3 Layer Boards offer enhanced strength, impact resistance, and a glossy, waterproof surface—perfect for modern construction needs. With a wood powder-rich core, it ensures higher screw-holding capacity, durability, and grip. Toxin-free, nonflammable, and chemical-resistant, it's the ideal choice for projects that demand performance, safety, and style.
extendedDescription: The tri-layer configuration sandwiches a dense, fiber-reinforced core between two ultra-hard, non-porous outer layers. This delivers a board with vastly superior flexural strength, rigidity, and surface hardness compared to conventional single-layer boards.
The smooth glossy skin resists scratches, chemical cleaning agents, and heavy impacts, making it the premier choice for modular casework, kitchen counters, and load-bearing interior fitouts.
